visuals.purpose: Visualize where the ms accumulate between signal and fill.
visuals.alt: Flowchart showing signal generation, network transit, broker routing, and matching engine as four latency stages.
visuals.caption: Each stage adds variable latency; the p99 outlier is usually the broker, not the wire.

visuals.alt: Bar chart comparing p50 and p99 latency in milliseconds across ECN, market-maker, and crypto exchange brokers.
